scope: Development-image cold-cluster recovery. The original kind control plane is destroyed, a separate cluster is provisioned after loss, and namespace state is rebuilt from an encrypted backup. Final-profile, in-flight and final-artifact acceptance remain required.
consistencyAssumptions: Disposable isolated source; schema and grants do not change during backup; one declared data write occurs after backup completion

steps.action: verify the explicit database Docker endpoint
enable durable delivery on the recorded recovery installation
connect owned database to task cluster network
record the installed Helm release state
archive the stored release manifests and hooks
back up database including actual history
bind source API node names to the recorded Docker cluster
destroy the recorded source kind cluster
verify no source cluster containers survive
provision a separate recovery cluster after source loss
enable durable delivery on the recorded recovery installation
record the installed Helm release state
archive the stored release manifests and hooks
read the existing recovery evidence recipient
connect owned database to task cluster network
route database service to restored instance
confirm original authorization was not recreated

rebuild.archiveOnly: Old plans, chunks, approvals and execution records retain their original identities in the encrypted backup. They are not re-created as authorization for new UIDs.

recoveredDelivery.mode: new installation and authority; original bindings remain archived

namespaceCleanup: Included in required source and replacement cluster teardown
